introduction.title: Introduction
paragraphs: This document contains information about the technologies that allow this Application to achieve the purposes described below. These technologies allow the Owner to collect and store information (for example by using cookies) or to use resources (for example by running a script) on the User's device when the latter interacts with this Application.
For simplicity, in this document such technologies are collectively defined as “Tracking Tools”, unless there is reason to differentiate.

Some of the purposes for which Tracking Tools are used may also require the User's consent. If consent is given, it can be withdrawn at any time by following the instructions contained in this document.
This Application uses only Tracking Tools managed directly by the Owner (commonly known as “first-party” Tracking Tools).

usage.title: How this Application uses Tracking Tools

sections.subtitle: Necessary
paragraphs: This Application uses so-called “technical” cookies or other similar Tracking Tools to carry out activities strictly necessary to ensure the functioning or provision of the Service.

consent.title: How to manage preferences and give or withdraw consent
paragraphs: When Tracking Tools are used based on consent, the User can give or withdraw such consent by setting or updating their preferences through the dedicated privacy choices panel available on this Application.

deviceSettings.title: How to control or delete cookies and similar technologies
deviceSettings.intro: Users can use their browser settings to:
list: See which cookies or other similar technologies have been set on the device;
Delete cookies or similar technologies from the browser.
deviceSettings.note: Browser settings, however, do not allow granular consent control by category.
deviceSettings.linksIntro: Users can, for example, find information on how to manage cookies in some of the most popular browsers at the following addresses:
extraParagraphs: Users can also manage certain Tracking Tools for mobile applications by disabling them through the relevant device settings, such as advertising settings for mobile devices or the general tracking settings.

consequences.title: Consequences related to refusing Tracking Tools
paragraphs: Users are free to decide whether to allow the use of Tracking Tools. However, please note that these tools allow this Application to provide a better experience and advanced features. Therefore, if the User decides to block their use, the Owner may be unable to provide the related functionality.

dataTypes.title: Types of data collected
paragraphs: The Owner does not provide a list of types of Personal Data collected.
Full details on each type of Personal Data collected are provided in the dedicated sections of this privacy policy or through specific information texts displayed before the data collection.
Personal Data may be freely provided by the User or, in the case of Usage Data, collected automatically when using this Application.

Unless otherwise specified, all Data requested by this Application are mandatory. If the User refuses to provide them, it may be impossible for this Application to provide the Service. Where this Application indicates certain Data as optional, Users are free not to communicate such Data without consequences.
Users who have doubts about which Data are mandatory are encouraged to contact the Owner.

Any use of Cookies – or other tracking tools – by this Application or the owners of third-party services used by this Application serves to provide the Service requested by the User, as well as the additional purposes described in this document and in the Cookie Policy.
The User is responsible for third-party Personal Data obtained, published or shared through this Application.

processing.title: Methods and place of processing the collected Data

sections.title: Methods of processing
paragraphs: The Owner takes appropriate security measures to prevent unauthorized access, disclosure, modification or destruction of Personal Data.

Processing is carried out using IT and/or telematic tools, following organizational methods and logic strictly related to the purposes indicated. In addition to the Owner, other parties involved in the organization of this Application or external parties (such as third-party technical service providers, mail carriers, hosting providers, IT companies, communication agencies) may have access to the Data and may be appointed, if necessary, as Data Processors.

sections.title: Place
paragraphs: The Data is processed at the operating offices of the Owner and in any other place where the parties involved in the processing are located. For further information, contact the Owner.

The User's Personal Data may be transferred to a country other than the one in which the User is located. For information on the processing location, the User can refer to the section containing details on the processing of Personal Data.

sections.title: Retention time
paragraphs: Unless otherwise indicated in this document, Personal Data are processed and stored for the time required by the purpose for which they were collected and may be kept for a longer period due to legal obligations or based on the Users' consent.

legalBasis.title: Legal basis of processing
legalBasis.intro: The Owner may process Personal Data relating to the User if one of the following applies:
list: the User has given consent for one or more specific purposes;
processing is necessary for the performance of a contract with the User and/or for any pre-contractual obligations thereof;
processing is necessary for compliance with a legal obligation to which the Owner is subject;
processing is related to a task that is carried out in the public interest or in the exercise of official authority vested in the Owner;
processing is necessary for the purposes of the legitimate interests pursued by the Owner or by a third party.
legalBasis.conclusion: Users can always ask the Owner to clarify the specific legal basis for each processing and to specify whether it is based on statutory law, provided for by a contract or necessary to enter into a contract.

retention.title: Information on retention time
paragraphs: Unless otherwise indicated, Personal Data are processed and stored for the time required by the purpose for which they were collected and may be kept for a longer period for legal obligations or based on consent.
Therefore:
list: Personal Data collected for purposes related to the performance of a contract between the Owner and the User shall be retained until such contract has been fully performed.
Personal Data collected for purposes related to the legitimate interests of the Owner shall be retained as long as needed to fulfill such purposes.
When processing is based on the User's consent, the Owner may retain Personal Data for a longer period until such consent is withdrawn.

userRights.title: Users’ rights under GDPR
userRights.intro: Users may exercise certain rights regarding their Data processed by the Owner.
list: object to processing of their Data;
restrict the processing of their Data;
obtain the erasure or removal of their Personal Data;
receive their Data and have it transferred to another controller;

exercise.title: How to exercise these rights
paragraphs: Any requests can be addressed to the Owner through the contact details provided in this document. Such requests are free of charge and will be processed by the Owner as early as possible and always within one month.

sections.title: Legal action
paragraphs: The User's Personal Data may be used for legal purposes by the Owner in Court or in the stages leading to possible legal action arising from improper use of this Application or the related Services.

sections.title: Additional information
paragraphs: Upon request, this Application may provide the User with additional and contextual information concerning specific Services or the collection and processing of Personal Data.

sections.title: System logs and maintenance
paragraphs: For operation and maintenance purposes, this Application and any third-party services may collect system logs, i.e., files that record interactions and may also contain Personal Data, such as the User's IP address.

sections.title: Information not contained in this policy
paragraphs: More details concerning the processing of Personal Data may be requested from the Owner at any time.

sections.title: Changes to this privacy policy
paragraphs: The Owner reserves the right to make changes to this privacy policy at any time by notifying Users on this page and, if possible, on this Application.
